title: One reception
description: One observer's reception of one packet, derived from exactly one capture.

capture_id.description: The capture it came from. At most one reception per capture.

observer_key.description: The observer within the source, from the topic; null when the topic names none.

device_observed_at.description: The observer's own reception time, epoch seconds, only when trusted (README section 2).

hop_count.description: This reception's own hop count, from its path byte.

route_type.description: This reception's own route type, from its header.
